verdict.rationale: Data portability applies to a state business registry. The evidence touches it only glancingly: you can order certificates and certified copies of your entity's filings (docs-12), look up records in CCFS Search (docs-2), and voluntarily close the business to leave (docs-7, docs-8). Nothing shows a bulk export of all your data or any machine-readable or open format. Missing for 10: bulk export of all account and filing data, documented open or machine-readable export formats (e.g., CSV/JSON/API), and independent or hands-on confirmation of record retrieval.
